```{r cplex-setup}
# Section 2
# Set up Python and IBM CPLEX
python_bin <- Sys.which(
  "python3"
)
if (python_bin == "") {
  stop(
    "python3 was not found. Install Python 3 before continuing."
  )
}
run_python_command <- function(args) {
  out <- system2(
    python_bin,
    args = args,
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )
  status <- attr(
    out,
    "status"
  )
  if (is.null(status)) {
    status <- 0L
  }
  list(
    output = out,
    status = status
  )
}
check_cplex <- run_python_command(
  c(
    "-c",
    shQuote(
      "import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)"
    )
  )
)
if (check_cplex$status != 0) {
  cat(
    "Python CPLEX package not found. Attempting installation...\n"
  )
  system2(
    python_bin,
    args = c(
      "-m",
      "pip",
      "install",
      "cplex",
      "docplex"
    )
  )
  check_cplex <- run_python_command(
    c(
      "-c",
      shQuote(
        "import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)"
      )
    )
  )
}
if (check_cplex$status != 0) {
  stop(
    "CPLEX could not be imported into Python."
  )
}
cat(
  "Using Python:",
  python_bin,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "CPLEX version:",
  paste(
    check_cplex$output,
    collapse = " "
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r cplex-python-script}
# Section 3
# Create Python CPLEX solver
#
# Status codes:
# 101 = optimal integer solution
# 102 = optimal within tolerance
#
# Only these statuses are treated as certified solutions for
# threshold and breakpoint calculations.
CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT <- file.path(
  tempdir(),
  "solve_cplex_snr.py"
)
python_solver <- c(
  "import sys",
  "import cplex",
  "",
  "lpfile = sys.argv[1]",
  "solfile = sys.argv[2]",
  "time_limit = float(sys.argv[3])",
  "",
  "problem = cplex.Cplex(lpfile)",
  "",
  "problem.set_log_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_warning_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_results_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_error_stream(None)",
  "",
  "problem.parameters.threads.set(1)",
  "problem.parameters.mip.tolerances.mipgap.set(1e-6)",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    problem.parameters.clocktype.set(2)",
  "except:",
  "    pass",
  "",
  "if time_limit > 0:",
  "    problem.parameters.timelimit.set(time_limit)",
  "",
  "problem.solve()",
  "",
  "status_code = problem.solution.get_status()",
  "status_string = problem.solution.get_status_string()",
  "",
  "print('STATUS_CODE=' + str(status_code))",
  "print('STATUS_STRING=' + str(status_string))",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    feasible = problem.solution.is_primal_feasible()",
  "except:",
  "    feasible = False",
  "",
  "print('PRIMAL_FEASIBLE=' + str(feasible))",
  "",
  "if not feasible:",
  "    sys.exit(2)",
  "",
  "objective = problem.solution.get_objective_value()",
  "print('OBJECTIVE=' + str(objective))",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    gap = problem.solution.MIP.get_mip_relative_gap()",
  "    print('MIP_GAP=' + str(gap))",
  "except:",
  "    print('MIP_GAP=nan')",
  "",
  "problem.solution.write(solfile)"
)
writeLines(
  python_solver,
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
)
cat(
  "Created CPLEX solver at:\n",
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT,
  "\n"
)
```

```{r cplex-core}
# Section 4
# Exact fixed-size best subset selection using CPLEX
best_subset_cplex <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s,
    M = 20,
    time_limit = 300
) {
  n <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)
  work <- tempfile(
    "cplex_"
  )
  dir.create(
    work
  )
  on.exit(
    unlink(
      work,
      recursive = TRUE
    ),
    add = TRUE
  )
  lpfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "model.lp"
  )
  solfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "solution.sol"
  )
  con <- file(
    lpfile,
    "wt"
  )
  # Objective
  writeLines(
    "Minimize",
    con
  )
  writeLines(
    " obj: [",
    con
  )
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " + 2 r_%d ^ 2",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    " ] / 2",
    con
  )
  # Residual constraints
  writeLines(
    "Subject To",
    con
  )
  chunk <- 10
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    starts <- seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk
    )
    for (cc in seq_along(starts)) {
      start <- starts[cc]
      finish <- min(
        start + chunk - 1,
        p
      )
      txt <- ""
      if (cc == 1) {
        txt <- sprintf(
          " resid_%d:",
          i
        )
      }
      for (j in start:finish) {
        a <- X[
          i,
          j
        ]
        if (abs(a) < 1e-14) {
          next
        }
        if (a >= 0) {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " + %.12g beta_%d",
              a,
              j
            )
          )
        } else {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " - %.12g beta_%d",
              -a,
              j
            )
          )
        }
      }
      if (finish == p) {
        txt <- paste0(
          txt,
          sprintf(
            " + r_%d = %.12g",
            i,
            y[i]
          )
        )
      }
      writeLines(
        txt,
        con
      )
    }
  }
  # Big-M linking constraints
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " U%d: beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " L%d: - beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  # Exactly s predictors
  writeLines(
    " card:",
    con
  )
  chunk_z <- 25
  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk_z
    )
  ) {
    finish <- min(
      start + chunk_z - 1,
      p
    )
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " + z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }
    if (finish == p) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " = %d",
          s
        )
      )
    }
    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }
  # Bounds
  writeLines(
    "Bounds",
    con
  )
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " -%.12g <= beta_%d <= %.12g",
        M,
        j,
        M
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " r_%d free",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  # Binary variables
  writeLines(
    "Binary",
    con
  )
  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = 25
    )
  ) {
    finish <- min(
      start + 24,
      p
    )
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }
    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    "End",
    con
  )
  close(
    con
  )
  # Solve
  solve_start <- proc.time()[3]
  out <- suppressWarnings(
    system2(
      python_bin,
      args = c(
        shQuote(
          CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
        ),
        shQuote(
          lpfile
        ),
        shQuote(
          solfile
        ),
        as.character(
          time_limit
        )
      ),
      stdout = TRUE,
      stderr = TRUE
    )
  )
  solve_seconds <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    solve_start
  parse_line <- function(
      prefix
  ) {
    hit <- grep(
      paste0(
        "^",
        prefix
      ),
      out,
      value = TRUE
    )
    if (length(hit) == 0) {
      return(
        NA_character_
      )
    }
    sub(
      paste0(
        "^",
        prefix
      ),
      "",
      hit[1]
    )
  }
  status_code <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(
      parse_line(
        "STATUS_CODE="
      )
    )
  )
  status_string <- parse_line(
    "STATUS_STRING="
  )
  mip_gap <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      parse_line(
        "MIP_GAP="
      )
    )
  )
  if (!file.exists(solfile)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "CPLEX did not produce a feasible solution. Status: ",
        status_string
      )
    )
  }
  # Read CPLEX XML solution
  sol <- readLines(
    solfile,
    warn = FALSE
  )
  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )
  z <- numeric(
    p
  )
  for (line in sol) {
    if (!grepl(
      "<variable",
      line,
      fixed = TRUE
    )) {
      next
    }
    name_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'name="([^"]+)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (length(name_match) != 2) {
      next
    }
    name <- name_match[2]
    value_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'value="([-+]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (length(value_match) != 2) {
      next
    }
    value <- as.numeric(
      value_match[2]
    )
    if (grepl(
      "^beta_[0-9]+$",
      name
    )) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^beta_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )
      if (!is.na(j) && j <= p) {
        beta[j] <- value
      }
    }
    if (grepl(
      "^z_[0-9]+$",
      name
    )) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^z_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )
      if (!is.na(j) && j <= p) {
        z[j] <- value
      }
    }
  }
  selected <- which(
    z > 0.5
  )
  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
        as.vector(
          X %*%
            beta
        )
    )^2
  )
  max_abs_beta <- max(
    abs(
      beta
    )
  )
  # Only certified CPLEX solutions enter diagnostic paths
  reference_eligible <-
    !is.na(
      status_code
    ) &&
    status_code %in%
      c(
        101L,
        102L
      )
  list(
    beta =
      beta,
    selected =
      selected,
    rss =
      rss,
    status =
      status_string,
    status_code =
      status_code,
    mip_gap =
      mip_gap,
    solve_seconds =
      solve_seconds,
    max_abs_beta =
      max_abs_beta,
    reference_eligible =
      reference_eligible,
    cplex_output =
      out
  )
}
```

```{r data-generation}
# Section 6
# Generate one paired Monte Carlo replication
#
# Within each replication:
#
# - X is fixed across SNR values
# - true support is fixed
# - beta* is fixed
# - the raw N(0,1) noise direction is fixed
#
# Only sigma changes with target SNR.
generate_replication_base <- function(
    rep_id,
    n,
    p,
    rho,
    s_true,
    beta_min,
    beta_max,
    master_seed
) {
  set.seed(
    master_seed +
      rep_id
  )
  # Equicorrelated Gaussian predictors
  common_factor <- rnorm(
    n
  )
  Z <- matrix(
    rnorm(
      n * p
    ),
    nrow = n,
    ncol = p
  )
  X_raw <-
    sqrt(
      rho
    ) *
    matrix(
      common_factor,
      nrow = n,
      ncol = p
    ) +
    sqrt(
      1 - rho
    ) *
    Z
  # True support
  true_support <- sort(
    sample(
      seq_len(
        p
      ),
      size = s_true,
      replace = FALSE
    )
  )
  # True coefficients
  magnitudes <- runif(
    s_true,
    min = beta_min,
    max = beta_max
  )
  signs <- sample(
    c(
      -1,
      1
    ),
    size = s_true,
    replace = TRUE
  )
  beta_values <-
    signs *
    magnitudes
  beta_true <- numeric(
    p
  )
  beta_true[
    true_support
  ] <- beta_values
  # Common raw standard-normal noise direction
  #
  # Do NOT centre or sample-standardise this vector.
  epsilon_base <- rnorm(
    n
  )
  # Population covariance matrix
  #
  # Sigma_rho = (1-rho) I_p + rho 11'
  Sigma_rho <-
    (
      1 -
        rho
    ) *
    diag(
      p
    ) +
    rho *
    matrix(
      1,
      nrow = p,
      ncol = p
    )
  # Population signal variance
  #
  # Var(x' beta*) = beta*' Sigma_rho beta*
  population_signal_variance <- as.numeric(
    t(
      beta_true
    ) %*%
      Sigma_rho %*%
      beta_true
  )
  list(
    X_raw =
      X_raw,
    true_support =
      true_support,
    beta_true =
      beta_true,
    epsilon_base =
      epsilon_base,
    Sigma_rho =
      Sigma_rho,
    population_signal_variance =
      population_signal_variance
  )
}
make_dataset <- function(
    base,
    target_snr
) {
  X_raw <- base$X_raw
  p <- ncol(
    X_raw
  )
  # Population noise variance
  #
  # sigma^2 =
  # beta*' Sigma beta* / target_snr
  sigma_sq <-
    base$population_signal_variance /
    target_snr
  sigma <- sqrt(
    sigma_sq
  )
  # Raw signal and noise
  signal_raw <- as.vector(
    X_raw %*%
      base$beta_true
  )
  epsilon <-
    sigma *
    base$epsilon_base
  y_raw <-
    signal_raw +
    epsilon
  # Standardise X after generating y
  X <- as.matrix(
    scale(
      X_raw,
      center = TRUE,
      scale = TRUE
    )
  )
  colnames(
    X
  ) <- paste0(
    "X",
    seq_len(
      p
    )
  )
  # Centre y because methods are fitted without an intercept
  y <- as.numeric(
    y_raw -
      mean(
        y_raw
      )
  )
  # Realised sample SNR
  #
  # Diagnostic only.
  # It is not forced to equal target_snr.
  realised_snr <-
    var(
      signal_raw
    ) /
    var(
      epsilon
    )
  population_snr_check <-
    base$population_signal_variance /
    sigma_sq
  list(
    X =
      X,
    y =
      y,
    X_raw =
      X_raw,
    y_raw =
      y_raw,
    beta_true =
      base$beta_true,
    true_support =
      base$true_support,
    target_snr =
      target_snr,
    population_signal_variance =
      base$population_signal_variance,
    sigma_sq =
      sigma_sq,
    sigma =
      sigma,
    population_snr_check =
      population_snr_check,
    realised_snr =
      realised_snr
  )
}
```

```{r common-helpers}
# Section 7
# Common helper functions
ols_refit <- function(
    X,
    y,
    support
) {
  support <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        support
      )
    )
  )
  p <- ncol(
    X
  )
  if (length(support) == 0) {
    return(
      list(
        beta =
          numeric(
            p
          ),
        fitted =
          rep(
            0,
            length(
              y
            )
          ),
        rss =
          sum(
            y^2
          )
      )
    )
  }
  Xs <- X[
    ,
    support,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = Xs,
    y = y
  )
  if (
    any(
      !is.finite(
        fit$coefficients
      )
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      "OLS refit produced non-finite coefficients."
    )
  }
  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )
  beta[
    support
  ] <- fit$coefficients
  fitted <- as.vector(
    X %*%
      beta
  )
  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
        fitted
    )^2
  )
  list(
    beta =
      beta,
    fitted =
      fitted,
    rss =
      rss
  )
}
support_key <- function(
    support
) {
  if (length(support) == 0) {
    return(
      ""
    )
  }
  paste(
    sort(
      support
    ),
    collapse = ","
  )
}
safe_model_fit <- function(
    fit_function,
    model_size,
    ...
) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      ans <- fit_function(
        ...
      )
      ans$success <- TRUE
      ans$error <- NA_character_
      ans$k <- model_size
      ans
    },
    error = function(e) {
      list(
        success =
          FALSE,
        error =
          conditionMessage(
            e
          ),
        k =
          model_size,
        support =
          integer(
            0
          ),
        beta =
          numeric(
            0
          ),
        fitted =
          numeric(
            0
          ),
        rss =
          NA_real_,
        runtime =
          NA_real_,
        status =
          NA_character_,
        status_code =
          NA_integer_,
        mip_gap =
          NA_real_,
        diagnostic_eligible =
          FALSE,
        cardinality_source =
          NA_character_
      )
    }
  )
}
model_is_diagnostic_eligible <- function(
    model
) {
  if (
    is.null(
      model$diagnostic_eligible
    )
  ) {
    return(
      TRUE
    )
  }
  isTRUE(
    model$diagnostic_eligible
  )
}
```

```{r abess-wrapper}
# Section 9
# ABESS fixed-size path and native GIC estimate
fit_abess_path <- function(
    X,
    y,
    k_values
) {
  total_start <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- abess::abess(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    tune.path = "sequence",
    support.size = k_values,
    tune.type = "gic",
    lambda = 0,
    normalize = 0,
    fit.intercept = FALSE,
    early.stop = FALSE,
    warm.start = TRUE,
    num.threads = 1
  )
  total_runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    total_start
  models <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(
      k_values
    )
  )
  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      k_values
    )
  ) {
    k <- k_values[ii]
    model <- abess::extract(
      fit,
      support.size = k
    )
    beta_hat <- as.numeric(
      model$beta
    )
    support <- sort(
      which(
        abs(
          beta_hat
        ) >
        1e-10
      )
    )
    if (
      length(
        support
      ) !=
      k
    ) {
      stop(
        paste(
          "ABESS returned",
          length(
            support
          ),
          "predictors when k =",
          k
        )
      )
    }
    refit <- ols_refit(
      X = X,
      y = y,
      support = support
    )
    models[[
      ii
    ]] <- list(
      success =
        TRUE,
      error =
        NA_character_,
      k =
        k,
      support =
        support,
      beta =
        refit$beta,
      fitted =
        refit$fitted,
      rss =
        refit$rss,
      runtime =
        NA_real_,
      status =
        NA_character_,
      status_code =
        NA_integer_,
      mip_gap =
        NA_real_,
      diagnostic_eligible =
        TRUE,
      cardinality_source =
        "Exact"
    )
  }
  best_model <- abess::extract(
    fit
  )
  gic_size <- as.integer(
    best_model$support.size
  )
  list(
    success =
      TRUE,
    models =
      models,
    path_runtime =
      total_runtime,
    gic_size =
      gic_size,
    fit =
      fit,
    error =
      NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r l0learn-wrapper}
# Section 10
# L0Learn dense and adaptively refined path
fit_l0learn_path <- function(
    X,
    y,
    max_support,
    grid_points = 1200,
    upper_multiplier = 2,
    lower_multiplier = 0.02,
    refine_points_per_gap = 100,
    refine_rounds = 2
) {
  total_start <- proc.time()[3]
  max_support <- min(
    max_support,
    ncol(X)
  )
  pilot_fit <- L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    loss = "SquaredError",
    penalty = "L0",
    algorithm = "CD",
    maxSuppSize = max_support,
    nLambda = 100,
    scaleDownFactor = 0.80,
    screenSize = ncol(X),
    intercept = FALSE
  )
  pilot_lambda <- as.numeric(
    pilot_fit$lambda[[1]]
  )
  pilot_lambda <- pilot_lambda[
    is.finite(pilot_lambda) &
      pilot_lambda > 0
  ]
  if (
    length(pilot_lambda) <
    2
  ) {
    stop(
      "L0Learn pilot path did not produce a usable lambda range."
    )
  }
  lambda_upper <-
    max(pilot_lambda) *
    upper_multiplier
  lambda_lower <-
    min(pilot_lambda) *
    lower_multiplier
  lambda_grid <- exp(
    seq(
      from = log(lambda_upper),
      to = log(lambda_lower),
      length.out = grid_points
    )
  )
  run_cdpsi <- function(
      lambda_values
  ) {
    L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
      x = X,
      y = y,
      loss = "SquaredError",
      penalty = "L0",
      algorithm = "CDPSI",
      maxSuppSize = max_support,
      lambdaGrid = list(
        lambda_values
      ),
      partialSort = TRUE,
      maxIters = 200,
      rtol = 1e-6,
      atol = 1e-9,
      activeSet = TRUE,
      activeSetNum = 3,
      maxSwaps = 100,
      screenSize = ncol(X),
      intercept = FALSE
    )
  }
  fit <- run_cdpsi(
    lambda_grid
  )
  refinement_rounds_used <- 0
  if (
    refine_rounds >
    0
  ) {
    for (
      rr in seq_len(
        refine_rounds
      )
    ) {
      fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
        fit$lambda[[1]]
      )
      support_sizes <- as.integer(
        fit$suppSize[[1]]
      )
      ord <- order(
        fitted_lambda,
        decreasing = TRUE
      )
      lambda_ordered <-
        fitted_lambda[ord]
      size_ordered <-
        support_sizes[ord]
      gap_indices <- which(
        abs(
          diff(
            size_ordered
          )
        ) >
        1
      )
      if (
        length(gap_indices) ==
        0
      ) {
        break
      }
      extra_lambda <- numeric(
        0
      )
      for (
        i in gap_indices
      ) {
        upper <- max(
          lambda_ordered[i],
          lambda_ordered[i + 1]
        )
        lower <- min(
          lambda_ordered[i],
          lambda_ordered[i + 1]
        )
        if (
          is.finite(upper) &&
          is.finite(lower) &&
          lower > 0 &&
          upper > lower
        ) {
          local_grid <- exp(
            seq(
              from = log(upper),
              to = log(lower),
              length.out =
                refine_points_per_gap +
                2
            )
          )
          local_grid <- local_grid[
            -c(
              1,
              length(local_grid)
            )
          ]
          extra_lambda <- c(
            extra_lambda,
            local_grid
          )
        }
      }
      if (
        length(extra_lambda) ==
        0
      ) {
        break
      }
      new_lambda_grid <- sort(
        unique(
          c(
            lambda_grid,
            extra_lambda
          )
        ),
        decreasing = TRUE
      )
      if (
        length(new_lambda_grid) ==
        length(lambda_grid)
      ) {
        break
      }
      lambda_grid <-
        new_lambda_grid
      refinement_rounds_used <-
        rr
      fit <- run_cdpsi(
        lambda_grid
      )
    }
  }
  support_sizes <- as.integer(
    fit$suppSize[[1]]
  )
  fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
    fit$lambda[[1]]
  )
  beta_path <- as.matrix(
    fit$beta[[1]]
  )
  candidate_sizes <- sort(
    unique(
      support_sizes[
        support_sizes >= 1 &
          support_sizes <= max_support
      ]
    )
  )
  models <- list()
  model_counter <- 1
  for (
    k in candidate_sizes
  ) {
    candidate_indices <- which(
      support_sizes ==
        k
    )
    valid_supports <- list()
    valid_refits <- list()
    valid_lambda <- numeric(0)
    valid_rss <- numeric(0)
    valid_counter <- 1
    for (
      index in candidate_indices
    ) {
      beta_j <- beta_path[
        ,
        index
      ]
      support_j <- sort(
        which(
          abs(beta_j) >
            1e-10
        )
      )
      if (
        length(support_j) !=
        k
      ) {
        next
      }
      refit_j <- ols_refit(
        X = X,
        y = y,
        support = support_j
      )
      valid_supports[[valid_counter]] <-
        support_j
      valid_refits[[valid_counter]] <-
        refit_j
      valid_lambda[valid_counter] <-
        fitted_lambda[index]
      valid_rss[valid_counter] <-
        refit_j$rss
      valid_counter <-
        valid_counter +
        1
    }
    if (
      length(valid_rss) ==
      0
    ) {
      next
    }
    best_candidate <- which.min(
      valid_rss
    )
    best_refit <- valid_refits[[
      best_candidate
    ]]
    models[[model_counter]] <- list(
      success = TRUE,
      error = NA_character_,
      k = k,
      support =
        valid_supports[[
          best_candidate
        ]],
      beta = best_refit$beta,
      fitted = best_refit$fitted,
      rss = best_refit$rss,
      selected_lambda =
        valid_lambda[
          best_candidate
        ],
      runtime = NA_real_,
      status = NA_character_,
      status_code = NA_integer_,
      mip_gap = NA_real_,
      diagnostic_eligible = TRUE,
      cardinality_source = "Native"
    )
    model_counter <-
      model_counter +
      1
  }
  if (
    length(models) ==
    0
  ) {
    stop(
      "L0Learn produced no usable positive-cardinality models."
    )
  }
  model_sizes <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      x$k
    },
    integer(1)
  )
  ord <- order(
    model_sizes
  )
  models <- models[
    ord
  ]
  available_sizes <- sort(
    vapply(
      models,
      function(x) {
        x$k
      },
      integer(1)
    )
  )
  total_runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    total_start
  list(
    success = TRUE,
    models = models,
    path_runtime = total_runtime,
    available_sizes = available_sizes,
    missing_sizes = setdiff(
      seq_len(max_support),
      available_sizes
    ),
    number_distinct_sizes =
      length(
        available_sizes
      ),
    refinement_rounds =
      refinement_rounds_used,
    number_lambda_values =
      length(
        fitted_lambda
      ),
    fit = fit,
    error = NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r fixed-path}
# Section 11
# Build complete CPLEX and COMBSS fixed-size paths
fit_fixed_path <- function(
    method,
    X,
    y,
    k_values,
    cplex_time_limit = 300
) {
  models <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(
      k_values
    )
  )
  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      k_values
    )
  ) {
    k <- k_values[ii]
    cat(
      "      ",
      method,
      " k = ",
      k,
      "\n",
      sep = ""
    )
    if (
      method ==
        "CPLEX"
    ) {
      model <- safe_model_fit(
        fit_cplex_model,
        model_size = k,
        X = X,
        y = y,
        k = k,
        M = big_M,
        time_limit =
          cplex_time_limit
      )
    } else if (
      method ==
        "COMBSS"
    ) {
      model <- safe_model_fit(
        fit_combss_model,
        model_size = k,
        X = X,
        y = y,
        k = k
      )
    } else {
      stop(
        "Unknown fixed-path method."
      )
    }
    models[[
      ii
    ]] <- model
  }
  successful <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      isTRUE(
        x$success
      )
    },
    logical(
      1
    )
  )
  runtimes <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      if (
        is.null(
          x$runtime
        )
      ) {
        return(
          NA_real_
        )
      }
      x$runtime
    },
    numeric(
      1
    )
  )
  path_runtime <-
    if (
      all(
        is.na(
          runtimes
        )
      )
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(
        runtimes,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
  list(
    success =
      all(
        successful
      ),
    models =
      models,
    path_runtime =
      path_runtime,
    error =
      if (
        all(
          successful
        )
      ) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        "At least one fixed-size model failed."
      }
  )
}
```

```{r breakpoint-functions}
# Section 12
# Piecewise-linear breakpoint estimator
fit_linear_segment <- function(
    x,
    y
) {
  design <- cbind(
    1,
    x
  )
  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = design,
    y = y
  )
  coefficients <- fit$coefficients
  fitted <- as.vector(
    design %*%
    coefficients
  )
  residuals <-
    y -
    fitted
  list(
    intercept =
      coefficients[1],
    slope =
      coefficients[2],
    fitted =
      fitted,
    sse =
      sum(
        residuals^2
      )
  )
}
piecewise_breakpoint <- function(
    k,
    z,
    min_left = 2,
    min_right = 2
) {
  valid <-
    is.finite(
      k
    ) &
    is.finite(
      z
    )
  k <- k[
    valid
  ]
  z <- z[
    valid
  ]
  ord <- order(
    k
  )
  k <- k[
    ord
  ]
  z <- z[
    ord
  ]
  m <- length(
    k
  )
  if (
    m <
    min_left +
    min_right
  ) {
    return(
      list(
        success = FALSE,
        breakpoint_after_k = NA_integer_,
        s_hat = NA_integer_,
        total_sse = NA_real_,
        fitted = rep(
          NA_real_,
          m
        ),
        segment = rep(
          NA_character_,
          m
        )
      )
    )
  }
  candidate_indices <- seq(
    from = min_left,
    to = m - min_right
  )
  total_sse <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(
      candidate_indices
    )
  )
  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      candidate_indices
    )
  ) {
    split_index <-
      candidate_indices[
        ii
      ]
    left_index <- seq_len(
      split_index
    )
    right_index <- seq(
      split_index + 1,
      m
    )
    left_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
      x = k[
        left_index
      ],
      y = z[
        left_index
      ]
    )
    right_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
      x = k[
        right_index
      ],
      y = z[
        right_index
      ]
    )
    total_sse[ii] <-
      left_fit$sse +
      right_fit$sse
  }
  best_candidate <- which.min(
    total_sse
  )
  split_index <-
    candidate_indices[
      best_candidate
    ]
  left_index <- seq_len(
    split_index
  )
  right_index <- seq(
    split_index + 1,
    m
  )
  left_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
    x = k[
      left_index
    ],
    y = z[
      left_index
    ]
  )
  right_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
    x = k[
      right_index
    ],
    y = z[
      right_index
    ]
  )
  fitted_piecewise <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    m
  )
  fitted_piecewise[
    left_index
  ] <- left_fit$fitted
  fitted_piecewise[
    right_index
  ] <- right_fit$fitted
  segment <- rep(
    NA_character_,
    m
  )
  segment[
    left_index
  ] <- "Left"
  segment[
    right_index
  ] <- "Right"
  breakpoint_after_k <-
    k[
      split_index
    ]
  s_hat <-
    breakpoint_after_k +
    1L
  list(
    success = TRUE,
    breakpoint_after_k =
      as.integer(
        breakpoint_after_k
      ),
    s_hat =
      as.integer(
        s_hat
      ),
    total_sse =
      total_sse[
        best_candidate
      ],
    fitted =
      fitted_piecewise,
    segment =
      segment,
    left_intercept =
      left_fit$intercept,
    left_slope =
      left_fit$slope,
    right_intercept =
      right_fit$intercept,
    right_slope =
      right_fit$slope
  )
}
```

```{r diagnostic}
# Section 13
# Threshold and breakpoint model-size diagnostics
diagnose_model_path <- function(
    path,
    n,
    p,
    required_reference_k,
    required_k_values = NULL,
    require_complete_path = FALSE,
    ratio_floor = 1e-16,
    min_left = 2,
    min_right = 2
) {
  failure <- function(
      reason
  ) {
    list(
      threshold_available =
        FALSE,
      threshold_hat =
        NA_integer_,
      piecewise_available =
        FALSE,
      piecewise_hat =
        NA_integer_,
      breakpoint_after_k =
        NA_integer_,
      breakpoint_sse =
        NA_real_,
      reference_k =
        NA_integer_,
      sigma_hat_sq =
        NA_real_,
      curve =
        NULL,
      failure_reason =
        reason
    )
  }
  # Path must exist
  if (
    is.null(
      path$models
    ) ||
    length(
      path$models
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    return(
      failure(
        "No fitted model path was available."
      )
    )
  }
  # Keep successful and diagnostically eligible models
  #
  # For CPLEX, only certified 101/102 solutions qualify.
  # For other methods, diagnostic_eligible is TRUE by default.
  valid_model <- vapply(
    path$models,
    function(x) {
      isTRUE(
        x$success
      ) &&
        is.finite(
          x$rss
        ) &&
        length(
          x$fitted
        ) ==
          n &&
        model_is_diagnostic_eligible(
          x
        )
    },
    logical(
      1
    )
  )
  models <- path$models[
    valid_model
  ]
  if (
    length(
      models
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    return(
      failure(
        "No eligible fitted models were available."
      )
    )
  }
  model_k <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      as.integer(
        x$k
      )
    },
    integer(
      1
    )
  )
  ord <- order(
    model_k
  )
  models <- models[
    ord
  ]
  model_k <- model_k[
    ord
  ]
  # Complete path requirement
  #
  # CPLEX, COMBSS and ABESS require all k = 1,...,8.
  #
  # L0Learn uses FALSE because its native path may skip sizes.
  if (
    require_complete_path
  ) {
    missing_required <- setdiff(
      required_k_values,
      model_k
    )
    if (
      length(
        missing_required
      ) >
        0
    ) {
      return(
        failure(
          paste(
            "Complete eligible path unavailable. Missing k:",
            paste(
              missing_required,
              collapse = ", "
            )
          )
        )
      )
    }
  }
  # Reference model k_max must exist
  reference_match <- which(
    model_k ==
      required_reference_k
  )
  if (
    length(
      reference_match
    ) !=
      1
  ) {
    return(
      failure(
        paste(
          "Eligible reference model k =",
          required_reference_k,
          "was not available."
        )
      )
    )
  }
  keep <-
    model_k <=
    required_reference_k
  models <- models[
    keep
  ]
  model_k <- model_k[
    keep
  ]
  reference_index <- which(
    model_k ==
      required_reference_k
  )
  reference_model <- models[[
    reference_index
  ]]
  reference_k <-
    required_reference_k
  fitted_reference <-
    reference_model$fitted
  rss_reference <-
    reference_model$rss
  # Residual variance estimate
  #
  # sigma_hat^2 = RSS(k_max)/(n-k_max)
  sigma_hat_sq <-
    rss_reference /
    (
      n -
        reference_k
    )
  if (
    !is.finite(
      sigma_hat_sq
    ) ||
    sigma_hat_sq <=
      0
  ) {
    return(
      failure(
        "Reference-model variance estimate was invalid."
      )
    )
  }
  # Calculate Score(k), Level(k), R(k)
  score <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(
      models
    )
  )
  level <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(
      models
    )
  )
  ratio <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(
      models
    )
  )
  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      models
    )
  ) {
    model <- models[[
      ii
    ]]
    k_i <- model$k
    score[ii] <- sum(
      (
        model$fitted -
          fitted_reference
      )^2
    )
    level[ii] <-
      4 *
      (
        sqrt(
          k_i
        ) +
          sqrt(
            reference_k
          )
      )^2 *
      (
        2 *
          log(
            p
          ) +
          log(
            n
          ) +
          1
      ) *
      sigma_hat_sq
    ratio[ii] <-
      score[ii] /
      level[ii]
  }
  curve <- data.frame(
    k =
      model_k,
    score =
      score,
    level =
      level,
    ratio =
      ratio,
    is_reference =
      model_k ==
      reference_k,
    used_in_piecewise =
      model_k <
      reference_k,
    log10_ratio =
      NA_real_,
    piecewise_fit =
      NA_real_,
    piecewise_segment =
      NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )
  # Threshold estimator
  #
  # IMPORTANT:
  #
  # k_max MUST be excluded because R(k_max) = 0 by construction.
  qualifying <- curve$k[
    is.finite(
      curve$ratio
    ) &
      curve$k <
      reference_k &
      curve$ratio <=
      1
  ]
  threshold_hat <-
    if (
      length(
        qualifying
      ) >
        0
    ) {
      min(
        qualifying
      )
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  threshold_available <-
    !is.na(
      threshold_hat
    )
  # Piecewise estimator
  #
  # k_max excluded.
  piecewise_indices <- which(
    curve$k <
      reference_k
  )
  piecewise_k <- curve$k[
    piecewise_indices
  ]
  piecewise_ratio <- curve$ratio[
    piecewise_indices
  ]
  piecewise_z <- log10(
    pmax(
      piecewise_ratio,
      ratio_floor
    )
  )
  curve$log10_ratio[
    piecewise_indices
  ] <- piecewise_z
  breakpoint <- piecewise_breakpoint(
    k =
      piecewise_k,
    z =
      piecewise_z,
    min_left =
      min_left,
    min_right =
      min_right
  )
  piecewise_available <-
    isTRUE(
      breakpoint$success
    )
  piecewise_hat <-
    if (
      piecewise_available
    ) {
      breakpoint$s_hat
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  breakpoint_after_k <-
    if (
      piecewise_available
    ) {
      breakpoint$breakpoint_after_k
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  if (
    piecewise_available
  ) {
    curve$piecewise_fit[
      piecewise_indices
    ] <- breakpoint$fitted
    curve$piecewise_segment[
      piecewise_indices
    ] <- breakpoint$segment
  }
  list(
    threshold_available =
      threshold_available,
    threshold_hat =
      threshold_hat,
    piecewise_available =
      piecewise_available,
    piecewise_hat =
      piecewise_hat,
    breakpoint_after_k =
      breakpoint_after_k,
    breakpoint_sse =
      if (
        piecewise_available
      ) {
        breakpoint$total_sse
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    reference_k =
      reference_k,
    sigma_hat_sq =
      sigma_hat_sq,
    curve =
      curve,
    failure_reason =
      NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r result-helpers}
# Section 14
# Result-table helper functions
path_to_table <- function(
    path,
    rep_id,
    snr,
    method
) {
  if (
    is.null(
      path$models
    ) ||
    length(
      path$models
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    return(
      data.frame()
    )
  }
  rows <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(
      path$models
    )
  )
  for (
    ii in seq_along(
      path$models
    )
  ) {
    model <- path$models[[
      ii
    ]]
    rows[[
      ii
    ]] <- data.frame(
      rep =
        rep_id,
      snr =
        snr,
      method =
        method,
      k =
        model$k,
      success =
        isTRUE(
          model$success
        ),
      diagnostic_eligible =
        model_is_diagnostic_eligible(
          model
        ),
      support =
        if (
          isTRUE(
            model$success
          )
        ) {
          support_key(
            model$support
          )
        } else {
          NA_character_
        },
      rss =
        model$rss,
      runtime =
        if (
          is.null(
            model$runtime
          )
        ) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          model$runtime
        },
      path_runtime =
        path$path_runtime,
      cplex_status =
        if (
          is.null(
            model$status
          )
        ) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          model$status
        },
      cplex_status_code =
        if (
          is.null(
            model$status_code
          )
        ) {
          NA_integer_
        } else {
          model$status_code
        },
      cplex_gap =
        if (
          is.null(
            model$mip_gap
          )
        ) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          model$mip_gap
        },
      cardinality_source =
        if (
          is.null(
            model$cardinality_source
          )
        ) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          model$cardinality_source
        },
      error =
        if (
          is.null(
            model$error
          )
        ) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          model$error
        },
      stringsAsFactors =
        FALSE
    )
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    rows
  )
}
make_identification_row <- function(
    rep_id,
    snr,
    method,
    estimator,
    s_hat,
    s_true,
    path_runtime = NA_real_,
    reference_k = NA_integer_,
    failure_reason = NA_character_
) {
  estimate_available <-
    !is.na(
      s_hat
    )
  data.frame(
    rep =
      rep_id,
    snr =
      snr,
    s_true =
      s_true,
    method =
      method,
    estimator =
      estimator,
    s_hat =
      if (
        estimate_available
      ) {
        as.integer(
          s_hat
        )
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },
    estimate_available =
      estimate_available,
    correct =
      if (
        estimate_available
      ) {
        s_hat ==
          s_true
      } else {
        FALSE
      },
    absolute_error =
      if (
        estimate_available
      ) {
        abs(
          s_hat -
            s_true
        )
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    signed_error =
      if (
        estimate_available
      ) {
        s_hat -
          s_true
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    reference_k =
      reference_k,
    path_runtime =
      path_runtime,
    failure_reason =
      failure_reason,
    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )
}
diagnostic_identification_rows <- function(
    diagnostic,
    rep_id,
    snr,
    s_true,
    method,
    path_runtime
) {
  threshold_reason <-
    if (
      diagnostic$threshold_available
    ) {
      NA_character_
    } else if (
      !is.null(
        diagnostic$failure_reason
      ) &&
      !is.na(
        diagnostic$failure_reason
      )
    ) {
      diagnostic$failure_reason
    } else {
      "No threshold crossing before k_max."
    }
  piecewise_reason <-
    if (
      diagnostic$piecewise_available
    ) {
      NA_character_
    } else if (
      !is.null(
        diagnostic$failure_reason
      ) &&
      !is.na(
        diagnostic$failure_reason
      )
    ) {
      diagnostic$failure_reason
    } else {
      "Piecewise breakpoint unavailable."
    }
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    make_identification_row(
      rep_id =
        rep_id,
      snr =
        snr,
      method =
        method,
      estimator =
        "Threshold",
      s_hat =
        diagnostic$threshold_hat,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      path_runtime =
        path_runtime,
      reference_k =
        diagnostic$reference_k,
      failure_reason =
        threshold_reason
    ),
    make_identification_row(
      rep_id =
        rep_id,
      snr =
        snr,
      method =
        method,
      estimator =
        "Breakpoint",
      s_hat =
        diagnostic$piecewise_hat,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      path_runtime =
        path_runtime,
      reference_k =
        diagnostic$reference_k,
      failure_reason =
        piecewise_reason
    )
  )
}
diagnostic_curve_table <- function(
    diagnostic,
    rep_id,
    snr,
    method
) {
  if (
    is.null(
      diagnostic$curve
    )
  ) {
    return(
      data.frame()
    )
  }
  diagnostic$curve %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rep =
        rep_id,
      snr =
        snr,
      method =
        method,
      threshold_hat =
        diagnostic$threshold_hat,
      piecewise_hat =
        diagnostic$piecewise_hat,
      breakpoint_after_k =
        diagnostic$breakpoint_after_k,
      reference_k =
        diagnostic$reference_k
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      rep,
      snr,
      method,
      k,
      score,
      level,
      ratio,
      log10_ratio,
      is_reference,
      used_in_piecewise,
      piecewise_fit,
      piecewise_segment,
      threshold_hat,
      piecewise_hat,
      breakpoint_after_k,
      reference_k
    )
}
```

```{r main-simulation}
# Section 15
# Main Monte Carlo simulation
#
# Checkpoint saved after every completed (replication, SNR)
# condition.
#
# To resume after closing RStudio, rerun Sections 1-15.
# Initialise or restore checkpoint
if (
  file.exists(
    checkpoint_file
  )
) {
  checkpoint <- readRDS(
    checkpoint_file
  )
  if (
    !identical(
      checkpoint$signature,
      checkpoint_signature
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Existing checkpoint was created using different",
        "experiment settings. Delete or rename that checkpoint",
        "before running this experiment."
      )
    )
  }
  completed_conditions <-
    checkpoint$completed_conditions
  identification_results <-
    checkpoint$identification_results
  path_results <-
    checkpoint$path_results
  diagnostic_curves <-
    checkpoint$diagnostic_curves
  cat(
    "\nCheckpoint loaded successfully.\n"
  )
  cat(
    "Completed conditions:",
    nrow(
      completed_conditions
    ),
    "\n"
  )
} else {
  completed_conditions <- data.frame(
    rep =
      integer(
        0
      ),
    snr =
      numeric(
        0
      )
  )
  identification_results <- data.frame()
  path_results <- data.frame()
  diagnostic_curves <- data.frame()
  cat(
    "\nNo checkpoint found. Starting new experiment.\n"
  )
}
experiment_start <- Sys.time()
# Monte Carlo loop
for (
  r in seq_len(
    n_rep
  )
) {
  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n"
  )
  cat(
    "REPLICATION",
    r,
    "OF",
    n_rep,
    "\n"
  )
  cat(
    "============================================================\n"
  )
  # Generate one common replication base
  base <- generate_replication_base(
    rep_id =
      r,
    n =
      n,
    p =
      p,
    rho =
      rho,
    s_true =
      s_true,
    beta_min =
      beta_min,
    beta_max =
      beta_max,
    master_seed =
      master_seed
  )
  # Loop over SNR values
  for (
    snr_value in snr_values
  ) {
    already_done <- any(
      completed_conditions$rep ==
        r &
      abs(
        completed_conditions$snr -
          snr_value
      ) <
        1e-12
    )
    if (
      already_done
    ) {
      cat(
        "\nSkipping completed condition:",
        "rep =",
        r,
        ", SNR =",
        snr_value,
        "\n"
      )
      next
    }
    cat(
      "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n"
    )
    cat(
      "REP =",
      r,
      "| TARGET SNR =",
      snr_value,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
    )
    data <- make_dataset(
      base =
        base,
      target_snr =
        snr_value
    )
    cat(
      "True support:",
      paste(
        data$true_support,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Population sigma^2:",
      round(
        data$sigma_sq,
        6
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Population SNR check:",
      round(
        data$population_snr_check,
        6
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Realised sample SNR:",
      round(
        data$realised_snr,
        6
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    # CPLEX
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting CPLEX path...\n"
    )
    cplex_path <- fit_fixed_path(
      method =
        "CPLEX",
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      k_values =
        k_values,
      cplex_time_limit =
        cplex_time_limit
    )
    cplex_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path =
        cplex_path,
      n =
        n,
      p =
        p,
      required_reference_k =
        k_max,
      required_k_values =
        k_values,
      require_complete_path =
        TRUE,
      ratio_floor =
        ratio_floor,
      min_left =
        min_left_points,
      min_right =
        min_right_points
    )
    condition_identification <- diagnostic_identification_rows(
      diagnostic =
        cplex_diag,
      rep_id =
        r,
      snr =
        snr_value,
      s_true =
        s_true,
      method =
        "CPLEX",
      path_runtime =
        cplex_path$path_runtime
    )
    condition_paths <- path_to_table(
      path =
        cplex_path,
      rep_id =
        r,
      snr =
        snr_value,
      method =
        "CPLEX"
    )
    condition_curves <- diagnostic_curve_table(
      diagnostic =
        cplex_diag,
      rep_id =
        r,
      snr =
        snr_value,
      method =
        "CPLEX"
    )
    # COMBSS
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting COMBSS path...\n"
    )
    combss_path <- fit_fixed_path(
      method =
        "COMBSS",
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      k_values =
        k_values
    )
    combss_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path =
        combss_path,
      n =
        n,
      p =
        p,
      required_reference_k =
        k_max,
      required_k_values =
        k_values,
      require_complete_path =
        TRUE,
      ratio_floor =
        ratio_floor,
      min_left =
        min_left_points,
      min_right =
        min_right_points
    )
    condition_identification <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_identification,
      diagnostic_identification_rows(
        diagnostic =
          combss_diag,
        rep_id =
          r,
        snr =
          snr_value,
        s_true =
          s_true,
        method =
          "COMBSS",
        path_runtime =
          combss_path$path_runtime
      )
    )
    condition_paths <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_paths,
      path_to_table(
        path =
          combss_path,
        rep_id =
          r,
        snr =
          snr_value,
        method =
          "COMBSS"
      )
    )
    condition_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_curves,
      diagnostic_curve_table(
        diagnostic =
          combss_diag,
        rep_id =
          r,
        snr =
          snr_value,
        method =
          "COMBSS"
      )
    )
    # ABESS
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting ABESS path...\n"
    )
    abess_path <- tryCatch(
      {
        fit_abess_path(
          X =
            data$X,
          y =
            data$y,
          k_values =
            k_values
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        list(
          success =
            FALSE,
          models =
            NULL,
          path_runtime =
            NA_real_,
          gic_size =
            NA_integer_,
          error =
            conditionMessage(
              e
            )
        )
      }
    )
    abess_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path =
        abess_path,
      n =
        n,
      p =
        p,
      required_reference_k =
        k_max,
      required_k_values =
        k_values,
      require_complete_path =
        TRUE,
      ratio_floor =
        ratio_floor,
      min_left =
        min_left_points,
      min_right =
        min_right_points
    )
    condition_identification <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_identification,
      diagnostic_identification_rows(
        diagnostic =
          abess_diag,
        rep_id =
          r,
        snr =
          snr_value,
        s_true =
          s_true,
        method =
          "ABESS",
        path_runtime =
          abess_path$path_runtime
      )
    )
    # Native ABESS GIC
    condition_identification <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_identification,
      make_identification_row(
        rep_id =
          r,
        snr =
          snr_value,
        method =
          "ABESS",
        estimator =
          "GIC",
        s_hat =
          abess_path$gic_size,
        s_true =
          s_true,
        path_runtime =
          abess_path$path_runtime,
        reference_k =
          NA_integer_,
        failure_reason =
          if (
            is.na(
              abess_path$gic_size
            )
          ) {
            abess_path$error
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }
      )
    )
    if (
      !is.null(
        abess_path$models
      )
    ) {
      condition_paths <- dplyr::bind_rows(
        condition_paths,
        path_to_table(
          path =
            abess_path,
          rep_id =
            r,
          snr =
            snr_value,
          method =
            "ABESS"
        )
      )
    }
    condition_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_curves,
      diagnostic_curve_table(
        diagnostic =
          abess_diag,
        rep_id =
          r,
        snr =
          snr_value,
        method =
          "ABESS"
      )
    )
    # L0Learn
    #
    # Native observed-cardinality path only.
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting L0Learn native path...\n"
    )
    l0_path <- tryCatch(
      {
        fit_l0learn_path(
          X =
            data$X,
          y =
            data$y,
          max_support =
            l0_max_support,
          grid_points =
            l0_grid_points,
          upper_multiplier =
            l0_upper_multiplier,
          lower_multiplier =
            l0_lower_multiplier,
          refine_points_per_gap =
            l0_refine_points_per_gap,
          refine_rounds =
            l0_refine_rounds
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        list(
          success =
            FALSE,
          models =
            NULL,
          path_runtime =
            NA_real_,
          available_sizes =
            integer(
              0
            ),
          missing_sizes =
            k_values,
          error =
            conditionMessage(
              e
            )
        )
      }
    )
    cat(
      "    L0Learn observed sizes:",
      paste(
        l0_path$available_sizes,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    l0_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path =
        l0_path,
      n =
        n,
      p =
        p,
      required_reference_k =
        k_max,
      required_k_values =
        k_values,
      # L0Learn may skip cardinalities.
      require_complete_path =
        FALSE,
      ratio_floor =
        ratio_floor,
      min_left =
        min_left_points,
      min_right =
        min_right_points
    )
    condition_identification <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_identification,
      diagnostic_identification_rows(
        diagnostic =
          l0_diag,
        rep_id =
          r,
        snr =
          snr_value,
        s_true =
          s_true,
        method =
          "L0Learn",
        path_runtime =
          l0_path$path_runtime
      )
    )
    if (
      !is.null(
        l0_path$models
      )
    ) {
      condition_paths <- dplyr::bind_rows(
        condition_paths,
        path_to_table(
          path =
            l0_path,
          rep_id =
            r,
          snr =
            snr_value,
          method =
            "L0Learn"
        )
      )
    }
    condition_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_curves,
      diagnostic_curve_table(
        diagnostic =
          l0_diag,
        rep_id =
          r,
        snr =
          snr_value,
        method =
          "L0Learn"
      )
    )
    # Progress output
    cat(
      "\n  Estimates:\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    CPLEX: Threshold =",
      cplex_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      cplex_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    COMBSS: Threshold =",
      combss_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      combss_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    ABESS: Threshold =",
      abess_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      abess_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "| GIC =",
      abess_path$gic_size,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    L0Learn: Threshold =",
      l0_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      l0_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "\n"
    )
    # Append completed condition
    identification_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      identification_results,
      condition_identification
    )
    path_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      path_results,
      condition_paths
    )
    diagnostic_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      diagnostic_curves,
      condition_curves
    )
    completed_conditions <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      completed_conditions,
      data.frame(
        rep =
          r,
        snr =
          snr_value
      )
    )
    # Save checkpoint after every (rep, SNR)
    checkpoint <- list(
      signature =
        checkpoint_signature,
      target_n_rep =
        n_rep,
      completed_conditions =
        completed_conditions,
      identification_results =
        identification_results,
      path_results =
        path_results,
      diagnostic_curves =
        diagnostic_curves
    )
    saveRDS(
      checkpoint,
      checkpoint_file
    )
    cat(
      "\nCheckpoint saved:",
      "rep =",
      r,
      ", SNR =",
      snr_value,
      "\n"
    )
  }
}
experiment_end <- Sys.time()
cat(
  "\n============================================================\n"
)
cat(
  "EXPERIMENT COMPLETE\n"
)
cat(
  "============================================================\n"
)
cat(
  "Elapsed time in current R session:",
  as.character(
    experiment_end -
      experiment_start
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Completed conditions:",
  nrow(
    completed_conditions
  ),
  "of",
  n_rep *
    length(
      snr_values
    ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r summaries}
# Section 17
# Model-size identification summary
mean_safe <- function(x) {
  if (
    length(
      x
    ) ==
    0 ||
    all(
      is.na(
        x
      )
    )
  ) {
    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }
  mean(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
median_safe <- function(x) {
  if (
    length(
      x
    ) ==
    0 ||
    all(
      is.na(
        x
      )
    )
  ) {
    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }
  median(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
model_size_summary <- identification_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    snr,
    method,
    estimator
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    replications =
      dplyr::n(),
    estimate_availability =
      mean(
        estimate_available
      ),
    correct_identification_rate =
      mean(
        correct
      ),
    correct_given_available =
      if (
        sum(
          estimate_available
        ) >
        0
      ) {
        mean(
          correct[
            estimate_available
          ]
        )
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    MAE =
      mean_safe(
        absolute_error
      ),
    Bias =
      mean_safe(
        signed_error
      ),
    mean_estimated_size =
      mean_safe(
        s_hat
      ),
    median_estimated_size =
      median_safe(
        s_hat
      ),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  )
print(
  model_size_summary
)
write.csv(
  model_size_summary,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "model_size_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r recovery-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
# Section 18
# Correct model-size identification rate against SNR
z_crit <- stats::qnorm(
  0.975
)
correct_plot_data <- identification_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    snr,
    method,
    estimator
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    successes =
      sum(
        correct
      ),
    n =
      dplyr::n(),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    correct_rate =
      successes /
      n,
    wilson_denom =
      1 +
      z_crit^2 /
      n,
    wilson_center =
      (
        correct_rate +
        z_crit^2 /
        (
          2 *
          n
        )
      ) /
      wilson_denom,
    wilson_half_width =
      (
        z_crit /
        wilson_denom
      ) *
      sqrt(
        correct_rate *
        (
          1 -
          correct_rate
        ) /
        n +
        z_crit^2 /
        (
          4 *
          n^2
        )
      ),
    lower =
      pmax(
        0,
        wilson_center -
        wilson_half_width
      ),
    upper =
      pmin(
        1,
        wilson_center +
        wilson_half_width
      )
  )
p_correct <- ggplot(
  correct_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = snr,
    y = correct_rate,
    group = estimator,
    linetype = estimator,
    shape = estimator
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    width = 0.08
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ method,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = snr_values,
    labels = function(x) {
      format(
        x,
        trim = TRUE,
        scientific = FALSE
      )
    }
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x =
      "Signal-to-noise ratio",
    y =
      "Correct model-size identification rate",
    linetype =
      "Estimator",
    shape =
      "Estimator"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 13
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position =
      "right",
    axis.text.x =
      element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1,
        size = 9
      ),
    axis.title.x =
      element_text(
        margin =
          margin(
            t = 10
          )
      ),
    strip.text =
      element_text(
        size = 13
      ),
    panel.spacing =
      grid::unit(
        1.2,
        "lines"
      )
  )
print(
  p_correct
)
ggsave(
  filename =
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "model_size_recovery_by_snr.png"
    ),
  plot =
    p_correct,
  width =
    12,
  height =
    7,
  dpi =
    300
)
```

```{r example-diagnostic, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Section 21
# Example diagnostic at SNR = 5
#
# Replication 1
example_snr <- 5
example_threshold_data <- diagnostic_curves %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    rep == 1,
    snr == example_snr
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ratio_for_plot =
      pmax(
        ratio,
        ratio_floor
      )
  )
example_threshold_estimates <- example_threshold_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    threshold_hat =
      dplyr::first(
        threshold_hat
      ),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  )
p_example_threshold <- ggplot(
  example_threshold_data,
  aes(
    x = k,
    y = ratio_for_plot
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data =
      example_threshold_estimates,
    aes(
      xintercept =
        threshold_hat
    ),
    linetype =
      "dotted"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ method
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks =
      k_values
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x =
      "Candidate model size",
    y =
      "Score / level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(
  p_example_threshold
)
# Piecewise diagnostic
example_piecewise_data <- diagnostic_curves %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    rep == 1,
    snr == example_snr,
    used_in_piecewise
  )
example_breakpoints <- example_piecewise_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    breakpoint_after_k =
      dplyr::first(
        breakpoint_after_k
      ),
    piecewise_hat =
      dplyr::first(
        piecewise_hat
      ),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  )
p_example_piecewise <- ggplot(
  example_piecewise_data,
  aes(
    x = k,
    y = log10_ratio
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      y =
        piecewise_fit,
      group =
        interaction(
          method,
          piecewise_segment
        )
    )
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data =
      example_breakpoints,
    aes(
      xintercept =
        breakpoint_after_k +
        0.5
    ),
    linetype =
      "dashed"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ method
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks =
      1:(
        k_max -
        1
      )
  ) +
  labs(
    x =
      "Candidate model size",
    y =
      expression(
        log[10] *
        R(k)
      )
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(
  p_example_piecewise
)
```

```{r estimated-size-distribution}
# Section 22
# Distribution of estimated model sizes
estimated_size_distribution <- identification_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    estimate_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    snr,
    method,
    estimator,
    s_hat
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    count =
      dplyr::n(),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    snr,
    method,
    estimator
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    proportion =
      count /
      sum(
        count
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
print(
  estimated_size_distribution
)
write.csv(
  estimated_size_distribution,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "estimated_size_distribution.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
